mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( select tt.*, ROWNUM AS rowno from ( select received_seq as receivedSeq, received_time as receivedTime, result, unique_id as uniqueId, person_name as personName, device_no as deviceNo, device_name as deviceName, device_addr as deviceAddr, bio_type as bioType, busi_type as busiType, tenant_id as tenantId from view_today_trans_log order by received_time desc ) tt WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) table_alias WHERE table_alias.rowno >= 1

SELECT * FROM ( select tt.*, ROWNUM AS rowno from ( select received_seq as receivedSeq, received_time as receivedTime, result, unique_id as uniqueId, person_name as personName, device_no as deviceNo, device_name as deviceName, device_addr as deviceAddr, bio_type as bioType, busi_type as busiType, tenant_id as tenantId, temperature, temperature_floor as temperatureFloor, temperature_top as temperatureTop, temperature_result as temperatureResult, health_result as healthResult, health_message as healthMessage from view_today_face_log order by received_time desc ) tt WHERE ROWNUM <= 8 ) table_alias WHERE table_alias.rowno >= 1

SELECT * FROM ( select tt.*, ROWNUM AS rowno from ( select received_seq as receivedSeq, received_time as receivedTime, result, unique_id as uniqueId, person_name as personName, device_no as deviceNo, device_name as deviceName, device_addr as deviceAddr, bio_type as bioType, busi_type as busiType, tenant_id as tenantId, temperature, temperature_floor as temperatureFloor, temperature_top as temperatureTop, temperature_result as temperatureResult, health_result as healthResult, health_message as healthMessage from view_today_face_log where temperature >= temperature_top or temperature < temperature_floor or temperature_result = '2' or temperature_result = '3' or health_message = '黄码' or health_message = '红码' order by received_time desc ) tt WHERE ROWNUM <= 4 ) table_alias WHERE table_alias.rowno >= 1
